scoring_justification: Cannot recompute formation energies and migration barriers from first principles without full DFT calculations; instead check structural trends (relative ordering, sign, ratio, monotonicity) and result-level thresholds.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values from paper for formation energies, migration barriers, AIMD jump counts, and Ce3+ barriers to validate trends and set thresholds.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper results (Table/Figures) encoded in reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numbers and stored inline.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual values reported in the paper, used solely to verify that the reference solution scores full reward and to set directional trends; they do not need to match exactly due to tolerance.

schema.single_vacancy: object mapping charge state string (e.g., '0', '2+') to formation energy (eV, float)
schema.cluster_vacancy: object mapping charge state string to formation energy (eV, float)
schema.relative_stability: object mapping configuration name (e.g., '<111>', '<100>') to relative total energy (eV, float)

outputs.description: Formation energies of single and clustered vacancies and relative stability of five short-range vacancy pair configurations.

schema.single_vacancy: object with direction string keys (e.g., '<100>') each mapping to an array of barrier values (eV, float)
schema.cluster_vacancy: object with direction string keys each mapping to an array of barrier values (eV, float)

outputs.description: Migration barriers of single oxygen vacancy and <111> vacancy cluster along different directions.
AIMD simulation analysis comparing diffusion behaviour of a single vacancy and the <111> cluster.
Effect of Ce3+ ion count near the migration path on the single-vacancy migration barrier.

output_contract.notes: All quantities are recomputed using an open-source DFT code; exact numerical values may differ from the original VASP+HSE paper. Scoring relies on reproducible trends and thresholds (e.g., <111> cluster is most stable, cluster formation energy negative under O-poor, cluster barriers >1.5× single-vacancy barriers, AIMD jump counts, monotonic barrier increase with Ce3+).

checks.description: Check that <111> configuration is the most stable (lowest relative total energy) among the five short-range vacancy pairs, and that the <111> cluster formation energy is negative under O-poor conditions.
Check that the minimum migration barrier for the <111> vacancy cluster is at least 1.5 times the minimum barrier for a single vacancy in each common direction (<100>,<110>,<111>).
Check that single vacancy system reports at least 3 diffusive jumps while the cluster system reports at most 1 jump (vibration).
Check that the migration barrier increases monotonically with the number of Ce3+ ions (barrier_eV should be non-decreasing as num_Ce3 increases).
